assumptions.statement: Official overall and three key-area GIS/CAD boundaries are not publicly available in the repository; maintainer proxy polygons are used only for concept review and recalculation.
assumptions.impact: Every design layer and area must be regenerated when official polygons are obtained.

assumptions.statement: Statutory land-use controls, FAR, height, setback, rail protection, road redlines, ownership and planning conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Development capacity and approval-oriented conclusions remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: The submission has no authoritative transport survey, road redlines, junction model, station interface or parking inventory.
assumptions.impact: Roads are conceptual centrelines; widths, capacity and engineering feasibility require specialist study.

assumptions.statement: No cleared parcel-level building survey, structural assessment, lease, occupancy or ownership dataset is available.
assumptions.impact: Building footprints are design envelopes and cannot determine retain, renovate or demolish actions.

assumptions.statement: Official heritage inventory, protection zones, railway-park boundary, views and archaeological constraints are unavailable; repository issues flag a location mismatch.
assumptions.impact: Heritage relationships, landmark sites and construction interfaces remain provisional.

assumptions.statement: Utility capacity, drainage, power, communications, district energy, fire and subsurface constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Infrastructure proposals are interface requirements without invented capacities.

assumptions.statement: Current population, facility supply, service catchments and departmental operating commitments are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Public-service nodes and quantities remain conceptual and require needs assessment.

assumptions.statement: No scenario-specific data controller, processor, retention schedule, security classification or impact assessment has been appointed.
assumptions.impact: AI scenarios are design prototypes with minimum-data, human-review and stop requirements, not deployed services.
